subject: Compatibility checklist, POC onboarding and exec readout window
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@medigen.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed POC scope and success criteria

Hi Alyssa — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and the suggested next steps so we’re all aligned.

Summary of discovery (key points)
- Primary priority: reduce inference latency at 95th pct for summarization pipeline (current 700ms p95).
- Secondary: reduce per-token cost for batched inference; budget target ~$0.004/token for production workloads.
- Compliance: platform must support customer-managed keys and audit logs for HIPAA-adjacent workloads.

Proposed POC (4-week lab trial)
- Week 0: onboarding + baseline measurements (integration with dev environment)
- Weeks 1–3: run representative traffic, implement prefix/KV cache and batching optimizations
- Week 4: final readout + exec go/no-go (metrics review)

Success criteria (proposed - please confirm)
- Latency: p95 <= 350ms for representative summarization batch (seq len ~512)
- Cost: >= 25% reduction in per-token cost vs current baseline with equivalent throughput
- Stability: <1% error/exception rate during steady-state traffic
- Controls: evidence of KMS integration + access log delivery to your SIEM

Ownership (suggested)
- Redwood: Aditya (commercial), Irene (platform integration), Lauren (solutions engineering)
- Medigen: Alyssa (product), Victor (VP Eng)

Attachments: POC_Scope_v1.pdf (draft) — contains test harness details and sample traffic mix.

Asks
1) Can you confirm the success criteria above or highlight priorities we should tweak?
2) Can you confirm the target 4-week window and point us to the person who will sign off at exec readout (VP Eng or CTO)?
3) Any compliance docs you need upfront? we can push SOC2 evidence + KMS architecture notes.

Irene and Lauren — can you review the proposed success criteria and confirm owners for the integration tasks?

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@medigen.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed POC scope and success criteria

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Priority order is correct: latency first, then cost. If you can hit p95 ~350ms we’ll be very interested.
- Compliance: we need customer-managed KMS and an audit log stream to our Splunk instance; SOC2 evidence is required for procurement signoff.
- Timeline: 3–4 week trial is fine, but we will need a firm readout date in writing for executive calendar alignment.

Sign-off stakeholders: Victor Ramirez (VP Eng) will be our exec for the readout; Alyssa will coordinate procurement. We may also include our Head of ML Ops for the technical readout.

Procurement note: if the POC demonstrates material improvement we will fast-track a pilot procurement. Payment/PO timeline is typically 30–45 days after contract signature.

I’ll confirm people's availability once Aditya proposes specific readout windows. Please include SOC2 evidence and a short KMS integration checklist in your next message.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Director, Product — Medigen Labs
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed POC scope and success criteria

Aditya — quick internal alignment and asks for Medigen.

Confirmed owners on our side:
- Integration & test harness: Lauren Bishop (solutions engineering) — lead for week 0–2 activities
- Metrics & readout pack: Marissa Cole (CS & trials) — lead for week 3–4 readout artifacts
- Platform/KMS work: Irene Choi (platform) — work with Alyssa to validate KMS key policy and log delivery format

Evaluation plan (draft)
- Baseline: capture 3 days of baseline production-like traffic (we’ll provide a small harness + sample script)
- Canary: run a canary bucket (10–20% traffic) to verify behavior before full-run
- Metrics: must include p95 latency, median, tail token cost, error rate, and cache hit ratio

I attached capacity_request.csv which lists GPU profiles we recommend for the trial. One ask for procurement: do we have permission to propose a short-term dedicated instance for weeks 1–3 (reduces noise for measurements)? If yes we will include cost delta in the POC_Scope_v1.pdf.

Action items for Aditya:
- Send SOC2 evidence + KMS checklist (Alyssa requested)
- Propose 2x possible readout windows in Sep (week-of options) so Victor can pick

Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Platform Integrations | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@medigen.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed trial schedule + readout windows and contract next steps

Alyssa — thanks. Proposal below based on your feedback.

Trial proposal (finalized)
- Onboarding week: Aug 30 – Sep 3 (baseline capture + integration)
- Trial run: Sep 6 – Sep 24 (3 weeks steady-state traffic)
- Readout / exec review: week-of Sep 27 (we propose Tue Sep 28 or Thu Sep 30)

Why these dates: gives Medigen time to prep, aligns with Victor’s availability window that you flagged (late Sep). If Victor prefers earlier, we can shift but please confirm.

Contract & procurement path
- If readout is positive, we propose issuing a term sheet within 3 business days and routing DocuSign to procurement (Alyssa) for signature.
- We can include a one-time trial credit and propose a pilot discount (20%) for the first 3 months of a pilot contract — subject to leadership approval.

Attached: SOC2_evidence_stub.txt (quick index of docs) and updated POC_Scope_v1.pdf.

Please confirm Victor’s preferred readout date and whether Medigen wants a dedicated instance for weeks 1–3.

Best,
Aditya
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@medigen.com>

Subject: Re: Proposed trial schedule + readout windows and contract next steps

Thanks — that looks reasonable. A couple of points:
- Victor prefers Tue Sep 28 for the exec readout; please reserve that slot in your calendar.
- We will accept a dedicated instance for weeks 1–3; procurement asks that any dedicated capacity pricing be called out separately so it does not impact PO terms for the pilot.
- SOC2 evidence is sufficient for procurement initial review; we will follow with more detailed controls if the readout goes well.

Procurement timeline: expect a 30–45 day PO after DocuSign. We will circulate a short intake form for legal once we have the term sheet.

I’m copying Victor on this thread to make the readout official.
